observation: Fresh main enforces validation command overflow as a hard failure, but browser checks were normalized with `.slice(0,8)`. A ninth browser target could therefore disappear silently and the remaining eight checks could still produce a passing acceptance receipt.
changes: Preserve the full normalized browser-check count long enough to detect overflow instead of silently truncating it.
Fail before browser execution with BROWSER_CHECK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED when more than eight valid check objects are supplied.
Keep exactly eight browser checks executable and include explicit observed/limit budget evidence in the failed receipt.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: nine browser checks were truncated to eight before any budget decision, allowing a possible partial PASS.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: nine checks fail before observer execution; eight checks retain their existing executable behavior.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/acceptance-browser-check-budget-integrity.test.mjs covers overflow rejection and the exact-eight boundary.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle only prevents silent loss of explicitly requested browser validation targets. It does not change what a browser check means or increase the established eight-check budget.
